claims.why: All accounts went from $259,250.85 to $299,195.04: +$39,944.19, +15.4%. No cause is stated.

claims.quote: Paid social was up ~72% as we put spend behind the Hearth fall launch on SocialReach and Clipstream
claims.why: Paid social went from $42,500.00 to $73,000.00: +$30,500.00, +71.8%. SocialReach threshold charges rose from 17 to 26 (+$22,500) and Clipstream's HEARTH_FALL26 campaign is new ($8,000). The SocialReach charges carry no campaign name, so only the Clipstream part names the launch.
claims.share_note: The launch spend is the whole increase in both vendors; SocialReach bills by threshold with no campaign in the memo, so no transaction set isolates it.

claims.quote: funded in part by pulling about $4K out of search.
claims.why: Paid search went from $18,399.90 to $14,349.90: -$4,050.00. Second claim of a two-claim sentence, stated as an action ('pulling ... out of search') rather than with a direction verb.

claims.quote: Affiliate & influencer spend rose $5.2K, mostly FX on the euro-denominated creator retainer.
claims.why: Affiliates & influencers went from $9,993.00 to $15,240.00: +$5,247.00, so the amount is right. FX is real but small: the EUR 6,000 retainer cost $6,543.00 at 1.0905 and $6,990.00 at 1.1650, +$447.00, 8.5% of the change. The driver is Affinity Network affiliate commissions (+$4,800) on launch sales.

claims.quote: Creative fell $12.7K as the Hearth shoot was a September cost.
claims.why: Content & photography went from $15,700.00 to $3,000.00: -$12,700.00. The Hearth campaign shoot ($14,500) was in September; October has $1,800 of Hearth retouching. Net of the two: -$12,700, 100%.

claims.quote: 3PL costs rose $7.5K, driven by storage as we built inventory ahead of Q4 (412 pallets vs. 286 in September).
claims.why: 3PL went from $34,851.10 to $42,392.66: +$7,541.56. Storage went from 286 to 412 pallets at $45 ($12,870 -> $18,540): +$5,670, 75% of the change; the rest is pick/pack volume and receiving. The pallet counts are not dollar figures.

claims.quote: Outbound shipping rose $6.2K, largely the carrier demand surcharges that kicked in this month.
claims.why: Outbound shipping went from $29,451.63 to $35,683.16: +$6,231.53. Three Harbor Parcel 'Demand surcharge - residential' lines are $4,920, 79% of the change.

claims.quote: Returns costs fell $2.3K thanks to the self-service returns portal we launched.
claims.why: Returns went from $5,881.88 to $3,614.53: -$2,267.35, so the amount is right. No portal appears anywhere in the ledger (no app, no setup fee) and return-label spend is flat (+$32.65). The fall is September's one-off freight of returns pallets to a liquidator ($2,300).

claims.quote: Processing fees were up ~$1K with the higher sales.
claims.why: Payment processing went from $11,480.00 to $14,585.00: +$3,105.00, not ~$1K (understated by two thirds).

claims.quote: Platform and apps rose $6K on the annual renewal of our on-site search app.
claims.why: Platform & apps went from $4,748.00 to $10,736.00: +$5,988.00, exactly the 'Searchlight Pro - annual plan renewal' invoice. The sentence describes the app rather than naming it.

non_claims.quote: October revenue was $1.48M, up 24%, with Hearth at 31% of sales; gross margin held at 61%.
non_claims.why: Revenue and margin are not expense accounts.

non_claims.quote: We expect social to stay elevated through Black Friday.
